text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I inform Mihono Bourbon of our plans for promo concerts and training leading up to the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make it clear that I'm not ordering her to take part—she should only join if she wants to. But she seems rather unsure of herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, if she ever decides she wants to perform, we can talk about getting her up on stage then.
